item.title: The future of NCAR remains highly uncertain
item.description: Members of the American Meteorological Society were briefed Wednesday about ongoing developments on the future of the National Center for Atmospheric Research, which the White House has said it will break up. The post The future of NCAR remains highly uncertain appeared first on Yale Climate Connections.

item.title: Tenemos que prepararnos para otro año de abundante sargazo
